description: Πρόγραμμα για την ενεργειακή αναβάθμιση των σπιτιών
programme_objective: Απαιτείται η participation of homeowners in the programme to improve energy efficiency and reduce energy consumption.

eligibility_criteria.name: Residency
eligibility_criteria.value: The property must be owned by a resident of Greece.

eligibility_criteria.name: Energy Performance Certificate
eligibility_criteria.value: The property must have an Energy Performance Certificate (EPC) rating of at least C.

property_requirements.name: Age
property_requirements.value: The property must be at least 10 years old.

property_requirements.name: Size
property_requirements.value: The property must have a minimum floor area of 50 square meters.

funding_coverage: Up to 100% of the total funding amount

energy_performance_targets.name: Energy Efficiency
energy_performance_targets.value: Reduce energy consumption by at least 20%

energy_performance_targets.name: Carbon Emissions
energy_performance_targets.value: Reduce carbon emissions by at least 30%
